description: Chord Plume shows who exchanges with whom, and how much, in both directions: migrations between regions, trade between countries, transfers between teams, customers switching brands. Drop a From and a To field and a Value measure, or a matrix (one measure per destination). Each name gets an arc; each ribbon links two names. Free features, no watermark Both directions: each end of a ribbon shows what that side sends, or one ribbon per direction with an arrow, or undirected. Readable labels: along the arcs, radial or horizontal with leader lines; they never overlap. Name, value and percent of total. Order: largest first, alphabetical, data order (Sort by column) or your own list. Busy data: small names grouped into Others, self-loops, value ticks. Power BI: hover an arc to isolate its flows, click to cross-filter, highlighting, tooltips and report page tooltips, right-click menu, keyboard, high contrast, English and French, 30,000 rows and more with fetchMoreData. Premium features ★ Play axis: one diagram per year or month, with animated transitions; arcs keep their place and color. Two half circles: origins on the left, destinations on the right (exporters and importers, channels and products). Indicator ring: sent versus received, net balance (who gains, who loses) or change since a reference period, with ▲ ▼ values. Smart order: fewer crossings (partners side by side) or net…
